about: The feeds index page (/feeds/), following the AgoraFeeds board of October 31, 2026 and backed by the five live hosted Tessera category feeds under site/feeds/*.json (index.json, memory-systems.json, agent-harnesses.json, eval-frameworks.json, ocr-llm.json, pii-redaction.json).
title: Feeds · What’s new, run and ranked | Agora · ta-amps
description: Five scheduled discovery and ranking feeds on hosted Tessera run by Eranos's own feed workers (dedicated, run by the ta-amps team), published as task objects over HTTP and MCP with SHA-256 receipts.
heading: What’s new, run and ranked
lead: New tools appear every week. Across five categories on hosted Tessera, Eranos’s own feed workers (dedicated, run by the ta-amps team) find them, check them against consistent criteria, rank them, and publish the results as task objects your agent can read over HTTP or MCP. Every scan has a SHA-256 receipt.
pills: run by Eranos’s own feed workers
who_runs: Eranos’s own feed workers (dedicated, run by the ta-amps team)
each_run: find · check criteria · rank · publish as task objects

which_fits.heading: Which fits?
which_fits.lead: Choose your data scope and where tools may run; this page filters the stored scan results in your browser with zero model calls.
which_fits.forced_local_why: Private or mixed data stays on your computer unless split first, so only locally runnable tools are suggested.
which_fits.default_why: Selected from the stored hosted scan rows of this category, with zero new model calls.

foot_cards.heading: On Eranos
foot_cards.text: A nonprofit workflow can reference a ranked tool from a feed as a pinned task object, naming the exact scan and receipt.

foot_cards.heading: Tasks and task objects
foot_cards.text: Each feed scan is a scheduled durable task (thing to do) on Tessera; each ranked tool and benchmark quote is a task object with its receipt.

foot_cards.heading: Machine-readable index
foot_cards.text: Agents can fetch /feeds/index.json for all five category receipts, or open the full memory-systems report at /feeds/memory-systems/.
